name: IG30RPS01 Analog ORP Electrode
shortDescription: An analog ORP electrode for water treatment and process monitoring, using a platinum sensing element and double-junction reference. Sample and standard calibration options, together with a mounting bracket and flow cell, support installation and routine measurement.
bodyHtml:
Product features:
◆ Rich configuration to meet various working conditions requirements
◆ Built in temperature sensor, automatic temperature compensation
◆ Automatic identification of standard solution, one point sample calibration
◆ The sensor is made of Ryton material, which has a longer service life and reduces maintenance and downtime
◆ Large capacity microporous double salt bridge makes the probe more resistant to toxicity and has a longer service life
◆ Thick and high impedance bubble with strong structural strength, not easily damaged by particle impact
◆ Ultra large platinum electrode improves the response speed and pollution resistance of ORP electrode
◆ Shielded shell packaging, not affected by environmental electromagnetic interference
Application areas:
Surface water, municipal sewage, environmental monitoring, industrial process control, pollution sources, industrial wastewater, tap water, biopharmaceuticals, beer and beverage, petroleum and petrochemical, metallurgy
Technical parameters:
Measurement range: ± 1999mV; Temperature:- 5-95℃
Resolution: 0.1 mV, 0.1 ℃
Accuracy: ± 0.5 mV
Working environment: 0-95 ℃
Response time: up to 95% in 30 seconds
Maximum pressure: 8.0bar
Maximum flow velocity: 3 meters per second
Calibration method: One point sample, one point standard solution calibration
Temperature electrode: PT1000
Electrode interface: BNC
Reference electrode: PTFE porous salt bridge liquid connection
Communication interface: ModbusRS485
Electrode material: PEEK、Ryton
Threaded interface: Front and rear standard 3/4NPT
Protection level: IP68
Cable length: Standard 10m, extendable
Electrode size: 165mm * 25mm
